manaNeeded: {1}{U} available the first turn, with {4}{U}{U}{U}{U} each following turn
notablePrerequisites: You have the city's blessing, and/or control (at least) eight permanents
description:
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Archmage of Echoes triggers, copying the Timestream Navigator spell.
Resolve both Timestream Navigator spells.
If you don't have the city's blessing, either the Timestream Navigator token or the nontoken Timestream Navigator gives you the city's blessing.
During your next turn, activate Riptide Laboratory's second ability by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning the nontoken Timestream Navigator to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate the ability of the Timestream Navigator token by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after that one.
Repeat.
